observations: Window opens 2466.63 (bar 1) and the final closed bar closes 2642.90 (bar 120), a net +176.27 change; bar 120 closes near its high (2616.09-2644.86 range) and is the highest close of the 120-bar window.

Bar 64 (1789128000000) is a single-bar bull spike: open 2457.12, high 2680.00, low 2444.19, close 2555.52, range 235.81, closing well below its high; that spike high was fully retraced 321.38 points to 2358.62 by bar 89.
Bull leg bars 89-111: from low 2358.62 (bar 89) to high 2700.00 (bar 111), closes stepping from 2397.10 to 2638.49 (+14.5%) with only shallow pullbacks (bars 108-110 lows 2608.83, 2604.75, 2622.67).
Bars 106-107 form a two-bar spike (open 2507.15 to close 2636.28, +129.13); bars 108-114 then closed inside a tight 2612.02-2640.01 band (27.99 points), i.e. overlapping bars.

Bar 111 printed the window high 2700.00 but closed 2638.49, leaving a 61.51-point upper tail; subsequent bars made lower highs 2658.79 (bar 113), 2645.88 (bar 119) and 2644.86 (bar 120), creating a resistance cluster at roughly 2643.5-2658.8 together with bar 107's 2643.52.
Bars 115-117 sold off to 2569.80 (bar 115 low; bars 116-117 lows 2570.00, 2568.16), breaking below the 2604.75-2608.83 base lows of bars 108-110.
Bars 118-120 are three consecutive bull bars closing at/near their highs (2611.00, 2631.93, 2642.90), recovering the bars 115-117 drop but not the 2658.79 lower high.
Swing progression: highs 2537.57 (bar 21) then 2680.00 (bar 64) then 2700.00 (bar 111); lows 2357.18 (bar 9) and 2358.62 (bar 89) differ by 1.44 points.

structures.description: Window-wide two-sided structure: floor effectively flat at 2357.18 (bar 9) and 2358.62 (bar 89) with rising highs 2537.57 (bar 21), 2680.00 (bar 64), 2700.00 (bar 111). Deep bear legs interrupt advances (bar 22 close 2450.96; bars 84-89 from high 2609.02 to low 2358.62).

Bull leg from the bar-89 low 2358.62 to the bar-111 high 2700.00: stepwise higher closes with overlapping bars, a two-bar spike at bars 106-107 (2507.15 to 2636.28), then a 7-bar overlap band (bars 108-114, closes 2612.02-2640.01) before the marginal new high 2700.00.

Post-2700.00 pause: bars 111-120 trade inside 2569.80-2700.00. Bars 111-114 close in a 2632.98-2640.01 band, bars 115-117 break to 2569.80, and bars 118-120 recover to 2642.90 while staying under the 2658.79 lower high.

Possible mtr-like topping attempt: new high 2700.00 (bar 111) with a 61.51-point upper tail, lower high 2658.79 (bar 113) and a bear bar down to 2569.80 (bar 115). Unconfirmed: bars 118-120 rallied back to 2642.90 and no swing low below the pullback has been broken on a closing basis; treat as a named pattern, not a reversal.

evidence_for: Higher swing highs within the window (2537.57 bar 21, 2680.00 bar 64, 2700.00 bar 111) with the latest pullback low 2569.80 (bar 115) holding far above the bar-99-105 base (2438.84-2507.31), so the higher-low sequence of the recent leg is intact.

One-directional recent leg: bars 89-111 advanced 2358.62 to 2700.00 (+14.5%) with pullbacks of only about 35 points (bars 108-110) before the 130.20-point test at bars 115-117, which was bought within three bars.

Bars 118-120 are three consecutive bull bars closing at/near their highs, and bar 120's close 2642.90 is the highest close in the 120-bar window, showing the two-sided pullback has been recovered by buyers.
The deepest bear leg since bar 89 stopped at 2569.80, above the bar-106 open 2507.15 and the entire bars 100-105 base, so sellers have not reclaimed the spike origin.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: the 120-bar context is two-sided with an essentially flat floor (lows 2357.18 bar 9 and 2358.62 bar 89, 1.44 points apart), so the recent advance is a rising-high leg inside a large range, and 2642.90 sits about 2.1% below the 2700.00 high rather than above it.

The 2700.00 high (bar 111) was rejected inside the bar (close 2638.49, 61.51-point upper tail), exceeded the bar-64 high 2680.00 by only 20.00 points, and was followed by lower highs 2658.79 (bar 113) and 2645.88 (bar 119), leaving an unbroken resistance cluster near 2643.5-2658.8.
Bars 115-117 broke below the 2604.75-2608.83 lows of the 7-bar base with expanding ranges, showing sellers can move price quickly; the recovery is only three bars and has not cleared 2658.79.
Prior spike highs have not held on this window: bar 64's 2680.00 high was retraced 321.38 points to 2358.62 within 25 bars, and the bar-111 spike high has so far produced a 130.20-point pullback.
transition_conditions: A close above 2700.00 with the next bar holding above it would confirm an upside breakout from the 2569.80-2700.00 range and strengthen the bull-trend/channel read.
Rejection inside the 2643.5-2658.8 resistance cluster followed by a bear bar closing below 2611.00 would suggest a double top below 2700.00 and shift the read toward trading-range or reversal.
A close below 2569.80 that is not reversed within two to three bars would break the recent higher-low sequence, flip Always-In short and expose the bars 99-105 base at 2438.84-2507.31.
Continued closes overlapping inside 2604.75-2645.88 would keep the phase a range inside the bull trend and lower Always-In relevance.
